title: Share your opinion
description: Practise giving opinions and responding to others.

items.targetText: In my opinion, flexible hours help people work better.
items.hint: In my opinion introduces your view

items.targetText: I agree with you, however I see your point.
items.hint: Agree with + however for polite disagreement

items.prompt: Give your opinion on remote work in two sentences.
items.promptIt: Esprimi la tua opinione sul lavoro da remoto in due frasi.
items.exampleAnswer: In my opinion, remote work is good for focus. However, I miss talking to colleagues in person.
items.hint: Use In my opinion and however
